scope: Remaining Ki Blast Ultimate taxonomy entries with explicit current-page metadata

records.name: Break Cannon
records.effect: Fires a charged Ki beam from the mouth; the attack scales with the user's available Ki. Current page lists 15 hits and knockback.

records.name: Crusher Volcano
records.effect: Creates and fires a barrage of Crusher Balls, finishing with a larger ball; current page lists tracking, long range, and 7 hits.

records.name: Dead End Rain
records.character_source: Android 18 Customize Partner; Android 17 (DB Super) Customize Partner
records.unlock_method: Expert Mission 13 - A History of Mixed Battles!
records.effect: Fires a barrage of Ki bullets diagonally downward over a wide area; current page lists 22 hits.

records.name: Perfect Kamehameha
records.character_source: Cell (Perfect) - Customize Partner; Cell (Full Power); Cell (Full Power) Supervillain; Mira - Universe 7 Clothing (2)
records.effect: Charges and fires a long-range Kamehameha; current page lists 21 hits and an unguardable attack.

records.name: Double Death Slicer
records.effect: Throws two Death Slicers; repeat input can make the discs track the opponent. Current page lists 1–10 hits and stun.

records.name: Scatter Kamehameha
records.effect: Fires a beam that transitions into a rain of small Ki balls; current page lists tracking and 8 hits.

records.name: Chain Destructo-Disc Barrage
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 46 - 16 of the Official History
records.effect: Launches five Destructo-Discs in sequence; current page lists 5 unblockable hits.

records.name: Requiem of Destruction
records.effect: Traps the opponent in a large Ki ball that paralyzes before detonating; current page lists 3 hits.

records.name: Power Wall
records.dlc_requirement: Legend Patrol / Hero of Justice content
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 150 - Battle of the Mind
records.effect: Creates a controllable advancing wall of flames; current page lists up to 17 hits and 500 Ki.

records.name: S.S. Deadly Bomber
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 115 - Extreme Battle with Android 13!
records.effect: Creates a tracking Ki ball that heat-seeks the opponent; current page lists 15 hits.

notes: All ten identities were absent from docs/data/skills.json at audit time. The current Ultimate Attack taxonomy explicitly supplies class, Ki Blast subtype, cost and acquisition for these entries. Where the source did not expose a reliable DLC field, it is left null; no Ultimate Finish requirement is inferred. 2026-09-25 evidence refresh: Break Cannon current page reports 300+ Ki; Perfect Kamehameha reports 400 Ki and Cell (Perfect) Lesson 4 rather than Skill Shop; Requiem of Destruction explicitly identifies Super Pack 2; the remaining records received direct current-page mechanic/source refreshes. Unresolved reward probabilities and version-sensitive details remain unasserted.
